decisions.reason: Official parent is Curtis L. Gerrish School of Business, but generic imported Business label and opened school overview do not establish an in-scope Operations academic unit. No department invented.

sources.note: Complete eight-school inventory verifies Curtis L. Gerrish School of Business and School of Science & Technology identities.
Business school identity and programme/learning-lab remit read. No explicit Operations/OR/IE/supply-chain research unit established.
Technical school scope explicitly includes engineering, laboratories and robotics but does not establish relevant IE/OR unit.

All programme accordions expanded and read. Business graduate provision MS Business Analytics, Professional MBA, Rising Professional MBA, MBA STEM Focus and MS Organizational Leadership; technical graduate offering MS Bioinformatics. Institution doctorates listed in nursing, applied behavior analysis and education, not Operations.

limitations: No qualifying Operations unit verified within current business/technical school scope; no claim that every historical unit is absent.
